## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and link the related issue.

## Verification

- [ ] `composer check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Affected page or API route exercised manually when applicable

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and uses an imperative conventional commit message.
- [ ] No credentials, `.env.local`, tokens, generated assets or `var/` content are included.
- [ ] Documentation and translations are updated where needed.
- [ ] Screenshots are included for board, dialog or visual changes.
